senses.gloss: (comp. of בְּ, דִּי, a. לְ = h. בְּשֶׁל) as to what refers to—whence; on account of, for the sake of, in order that.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 6:3">Targ. O. Gen. VI, 3</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 28:6">Lev. R. s. 28</cite>, end <he>אזל ב׳ בלנאי</he> he went for (the sake of getting) a bather.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 3:4:5">Y. Kidd. III, 64ᵃ</cite> <he>ב׳ דלא יכפור וכ׳</he> in order that he may not deny his owing a cup.

<cite ref="Yoma 75b">Yoma 75ᵇ</cite> <he>ב׳ רבא וכ׳</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) through the merit of the teacher is the scholar supported.—<he>בְּדִילִי</he>, <he>בְּדִילָךְ</he> &c. on my, thy account &c.
<cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 3:26">Targ. O. Deut. III, 26</cite>; a. e. (Y. <he>בגלל</he>; b. h. <he>למען</he>).
